description: This file defines safe numeric conversion functions and classes, including checked_cast, saturated_cast, strict_cast, and the StrictNumeric class, with support for range checking, NaN handling, and compile-time safety.

classes.name: StrictNumeric
classes.description: A template class for compile-time range checking of numeric types, ensuring safe conversions and assignments.

methods.name: IsValueInRangeForNumericType
methods.description: Checks if a value is within the valid range for a specified numeric type.

methods.name: IsValueNegative
methods.description: Determines if a numeric value is negative, with specialization for signed and unsigned types.

methods.name: checked_cast
methods.description: Performs a checked static cast that verifies the value is within the target type's range.

methods.name: saturated_cast
methods.description: Performs a numeric cast that saturates on overflow/underflow, with NaN handling options.

methods.name: strict_cast
methods.description: Performs a static cast with compile-time range validation, causing compile errors if out of range.
